title: README contradicts itself on the control paths: 'three paths' over a five-row table, and Known limitations denies the stored-parameter kind the table and options page offer
claim: README 'Supported heat pumps and controls' says control goes 'over three paths' (and 'the other two', 'all three' elsewhere) above a table of five rows. Its 'Known limitations' ECL110 bullet says 'an absolute or stored curve parameter is not supported in this version', while the same README's table row 'Heat-curve stored parameter (kind persistent)', its Removal section, docs/ecl110.md's 'Kind persistent' section and the options page (config_flow._OPTION_FIELDS selector for heat_curve_target_kind offers ['offset', 'persistent']) all support it. A reader checking limitations before installing is told a supported path does not exist.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: other seats running concurrently; counts are contention-immune
fan-out: other seats running concurrently; counts are contention-immune

perturbation: --perturb cuts const.HEAT_CURVE_TARGET_KINDS to ('offset',) before config_flow is imported: denied_kinds 1 -> 0 (executed).
metric_definition: Heat-curve target kinds the production options selector offers that README's Known-limitations ECL110 bullet declares not supported.
phenomenon_property: README's control-path count and its limitations agree with its own path table and with the kinds the options page offers.
seam_rule: grep -n -E 'three paths|other two|all three|not supported' README.md
proposed_fix_scope: README only: make the paths count match the table (or regroup the three heat-curve rows as one path with kinds) and remove the 'stored curve parameter is not supported' clause from Known limitations.
